Hi David —

Thanks for reaching out. I'm interested in the Fintech Compliance Dashboard and available to start next Monday. The $8,000 fixed budget and 6-week timeline are reasonable from my side, but I have a few quick questions before we proceed and I sign the NDA:

1) Will you provide a sandbox or anonymized transaction dataset / API access for development and testing?
2) Are there specific regulatory frameworks or compliance standards you need (e.g., PCI, GLBA, SOC2) that should shape the implementation?
3) Who will own deployment/production hosting and credentials? Do you expect me to handle deployment or hand off to your infra team?
4) Can you share any existing API specs, data schemas, or audit logging requirements?

I can sign the NDA — I see a DocuSign link in the thread and am happy to complete that. I'm also available for a 30-minute call this week to align on scope and deliverables. 

Looking forward to working together.

Best,
Jordan Mitchell

Hi Marcus —

Thanks for reaching out and for the kind words about my React work. I’m interested in building the analytics dashboard for your DevOps monitoring tool. The $5k–$6k budget and ~4-week timeline are reasonable from my side and I’m available to start next month.

Before we hop on a call, a few quick questions to clarify scope:
1) Do you have existing chart components (D3) or a preferred charting library you want to keep/use (Recharts, Chart.js, ECharts)?
2) Can you share the REST API spec or a sample sandbox so I can estimate integration effort (rate limits, auth, payload sizes)?
3) What auth provider do you use (JWT, OAuth2, SSO)? Any role types and permission matrix you can share?
4) Which browsers/devices must be supported for the responsive/tablet experience?
5) Any non-functional requirements (performance targets, accessibility, audit logging)?

I’m happy to do a 30-minute call this week to align on requirements and next steps. Please let me know a few times that work for you and I’ll confirm.

Best,
Jordan Mitchell
ML Engineer | TechCorp Inc.
